This is only a sanity check that the Sofic class is not vacuous. It does not prove or refute the existential nonsofic theorem, which is not tied to the Leavitt unit group.

theorem probe_sofic_subsingleton (G : Type) [Group G] [Subsingleton G] : SoficGroups.Sofic G := by
  refine ⟨fun F ε hε hε1 => ?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨1, Nat.one_pos, fun _ => 1, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g _ h _
    simp [SoficGroups.normalizedHamming, hε]
  · intro g _ hg
    exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim g 1) hg
